# WinCraft

> WinCraft is an Android field studio for aluminium window and door fabricators: measure on site, design the window and send a quotation PDF. The beta is Android only.

- Measure with a supported Bluetooth laser measure, or type the width and height.
- Draw sliding, casement, tilt and turn, louvre and other windows.
- Quotation PDF with your logo, drawings, specifications and totals; you enter quantity and unit rate.
- Projects are kept on your device. No sign-in, no ads.
